emotional_tone: Clinical precision, speed, reliability, and aggressive utility.
visual_mood: Swiss Brutalist, Neo-brutalist. Data-dense, stark typography, raw structure with hard borders and high-impact accent colors.

rules: Data points, prices, and timestamps must use JetBrains Mono.
Headings must be extremely tight in tracking.
Never center-align data or forms; strict left-alignment to enforce grid structure.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: The 'Control Room' Grid. Zero rounded corners. Hard 2px black borders everywhere. Density and scanability.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Strict mobile-first. All grid items stretch to match height. Subgrid where possible.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white border-2 border-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-transform
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-black border-2 border-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-white border-2 border-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-transform

cards.item_card: flex flex-col border-2 border-black bg-white shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all h-full
cards.badge_new: absolute top-2 left-2 bg-destructive text-white text-xs font-black uppercase px-2 py-1 border-2 border-black font-mono
cards.autobuy_indicator: absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black text-white text-xs font-black uppercase px-2 py-1 border-2 border-white font-mono flex items-center gap-1

inputs.text: border-2 border-black bg-white rounded-none px-4 py-2 font-mono text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]

motion.philosophy: Snappy, mechanical, immediate. No slow fades.
motion.hover: Hover states must pop and offset abruptly (e.g., hard shadow displacement).
motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-100 ease-out, transition-colors duration-100 ease-out

clothing_samples.description: Vintage shirts on rack (use for mockup item #1)
Neon green Nike sneakers (use for mockup item #3)
Red Nike sneaker (use for mockup item #4)

accessibility.contrast: Extreme contrast. Pure black borders ensure 21:1 contrast against white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, item cards) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid="autobuy-toggle-btn").

instructions_to_main_agent: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the provided css_variables_update mapping.
Change global radius in `index.css` to 0rem. We are using Neo-Brutalism (sharp edges).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavy customize them: remove `rounded-md`, add `border-2 border-black` and hard shadows `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]`.
For the live feed grid, items should appear to snap into place. Use the item_card component style.
The search creation form should look like a terminal or technical control panel: dense, clearly labeled with monospace fonts for metadata.
Use the provided image URLs as placeholders for the real-time Vinted feed.
Ensure the 'Auto-buy' toggle is extremely prominent, using the Red/Green color coding to signify danger/active state clearly.
